name: Sayonara Kyokou ~ Ai wa Engi de ATM ~
original_name: さよなら虚構～愛は演技でＡＴＭ～
source:
What is true love?

One day, after hearing something from his roommate, Shinya begins to ponder this question.

He thought he understood what love meant.

However, as he reflects on his own misunderstandings and the circumstances around him, he begins to question his assumptions.
